versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to functionality or documentation within SKILL.md.
No user-visible changes in this version; documentation and functionality remain unchanged.

- Initial release of statement-reconciliation skill.
- Confirms every invoice on a vendor statement is recorded in the AP log and flags missing or ambiguous entries.
- Drafts (but does not send) a vendor request for missing invoices; ambiguous matches are separately flagged for human review.
- Requires operator to specify match tolerance in plan mode—will not proceed with a blank tolerance.
- Ensures every matched line cites both the statement source and AP-log row for auditability.
- Safeguards against duplicate vendor drafts and accidental auto-sending.
